config.route:
- route:
    from:
      uri: direct:partner-agg4
      steps:
        - choice:
            when:
                - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'INQUIRY'"
                  steps:
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=INQUIRY.request"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/agg4/v1/bills/inquiry&auth=basic&userField=basic-user&secretField=basic-password"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=INQUIRY.response&definiteStatuses=200,422"
                - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'PAY'"
                  steps:
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=PAY.request"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/agg4/v1/payments&auth=basic&userField=basic-user&secretField=basic-password"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=PAY.response&definiteStatuses=400,422&pending=true"
                - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'STATUS_QUERY'"
                  steps:
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=GET&path=/agg4/v1/payments/{reference}&auth=basic&userField=basic-user&secretField=basic-password"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=STATUS_QUERY.response&definiteStatuses=200,404&pending=true"
                - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'REVERSE'"
                  steps:
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=REVERSE.request"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/agg4/v1/payments/{reference}/reverse&auth=basic&userField=basic-user&secretField=basic-password"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=REVERSE.response&definiteStatuses=404,422"
        - to: "kamelet:mw-audit"
